verdict.rationale: Extend is API-first: run outputs come back as structured JSON (chunks, metadata, schema values with confidence and citations), processor configs are plain `config` objects, and the CLI supports output and scripting, so a user can pull results programmatically. Deletion APIs exist for every resource, which supports leaving cleanly. There is no documented bulk export of all workspace data (files, processors, eval sets, workflows), so a full exit means assembling it yourself through the API. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export feature, explicit open-format export of processors, evaluation sets and workflows, and hands-on corroboration of migrating off Extend.
